learning_question: Which FTSE 350 names left by delisting between 2013-01-01 and 2025-09-30, and for which of those can Companies House supply point-in-time annual statements?
method: FTSE Russell historic addition and deletion logs (October 2026 PDFs) parsed by column. A row is a leaver when the note names that company as acquired, failed, or moved off the eligible London listing, and the name is not back in either index within 7 days. Empty-note quarterly deletions are demotions or promotions and are excluded. Wikipedia FTSE 100 past constituents were used as a cross-check, not as the date source. SABMiller is taken from the FTSE 250 note that records the FTSE 100 acquisition, because that row is absent from the FTSE 100 PDF.
completeness: 155 delisting exits. The Russell change log is the full official history through October 2026, so labelled takeovers, schemes, suspensions and listing transfers in the window should be present. Demotions of companies that stayed listed are excluded on purpose, which is why the count is not every name that ever left the index. Residual gaps are an omitted PDF row (SABMiller, recovered from the other index's note) and a failure deleted at a quarterly review with no note. Estimate: within about 10% of the delisting set.
licence: Index dates are from FTSE Russell historic constituent change logs. Companies House numbers and accounts, where present, are Crown copyright and reused under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
